description: This Java class 'ImportService' is responsible for importing book data from Goodreads format into the application's domain model. It processes collections of 'GoodreadsBookImport' objects, converts them into 'Book' entities, and persists them via the 'BookService'. It also handles the creation or retrieval of associated shelves and ratings, ensuring proper data transformation and validation.

classes.name: ImportService
classes.description: A Spring service component responsible for importing books from Goodreads data, converting data objects into domain entities, and saving them using dedicated services.

methods.name: importGoodreadsBooks
methods.description: Imports a collection of GoodreadsBookImport objects, converts them into Book entities, saves them, and returns the list of successfully saved books.

methods.name: toBooks
methods.description: Transforms a collection of GoodreadsBookImport objects into a list of Book entities.

methods.name: toBook
methods.description: Converts a single GoodreadsBookImport object into an Optional<Book>, handling validation and associated entity linkage.

methods.name: toAuthor
methods.description: Creates an Author entity from a name string if not blank.

methods.name: toPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Determines the appropriate PredefinedShelf based on shelf names, read date, and provided mapping, or defaults to the read shelf if dateRead is present.

methods.name: toCustomShelf
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a UserCreatedShelf based on shelf names that are not predefined.

methods.name: toRatingScale
methods.description: Converts a rating value to the application's RatingScale, applying a scale factor.
